findings.detail: On 2025-07-23, the transaction-walk reconstruction shows the portfolio going from $1,818 to $17,318 (net cashflow on this date: $0). That's +853% in a day — almost certainly an unrecorded position transfer or a transaction Plaid didn't capture. The TWR is held flat for this day to avoid compounding noise.
findings.recommended_action: Check the Transactions page for this date. If there was an ACATS transfer, gifted stock, or intra-account move that isn't reflected, you can ignore this; the TWR accounts for it. If it's a true data error, report to Plaid.
findings.title: 2025-07-23: reconstructed value jumped +853% with no recorded cashflow

findings.detail: The performance chart currently falls back to a 365-day transaction-walk reconstruction because we don't have enough observed snapshots to plot. Backfilled values are modeled from Plaid's transaction history and will drift on incomplete records.
findings.recommended_action: Schedule the snapshot job daily. After ~1 week of forward snapshots, the chart switches to observed data automatically.
findings.title: Only 1 day(s) of forward snapshots exist
